name: Apollo 14 LM
about: Apollo 14 LM (1971-008C), a crewed vehicle (LM AS), launched 1971 Jan 31. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DSO).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1971 Feb  1), held fixed
